newsitem.title: USA: World Satellite uses direct broadcast satellite.
newsitem.headline: World Satellite uses direct broadcast satellite.

text.p: World Satellite Network Inc said Wednesday it has begun providing satellite programming over a Ku-Band satellite through TCI Satellite Entertainment Inc.

Chief operating officer Robert Ringstad said: "This represents the first use of a direct broadcast satellite (DBS) to deliver satellite television programming to the commercial private cable marketplace." He said the technology provides greater progrmamming options for a lower capital cost compared with the current C-Band technology.
